'''''Coruscant Nights''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] put up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was an ad for the [[Coruscant Nights/Legends|source of entertainment]] of the same name.<ref name="Lethal" /> The poster was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] and showed the silhouette of two people set against a [[Color/Legends|blue]] background, the caption at the top reading "Coruscant Nights,"<ref name="Lethal" /> while the bottom read "[[Coruscant Ballroom/Legends|Coruscant Ballroom]]."<ref name="Lethal Trackdown">In "[[Lethal Trackdown]]," the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text "[[Coruscant Ballroom/Legends|Coruscant Ballroom]]" can be read at the bottom of a copy of the [[Painting/Legends|poster]], glimpsed over the entrance to [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]] as [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] says, "You may be surprised what people reveal when they have been drinking." If you compare the design at bottom of this poster to the full poster seen ''inside'' the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] (where only the "[[Coruscant Nights/Legends|Coruscant Nights]]" parts can be deciphered), you can see that it is the same poster, meaning that it reads "Coruscant Nights" at the top and "Coruscant Ballroom" at the bottom. The full version of the poster ''over the cantina entrance'' can also be seen in the wide shot of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] leaving the bar, but only from a distance.</ref> It could be found in a [[Unidentified massage parlor/Legends|massage parlor]] located in [[Slum district G17/Legends|Slum district &17]],<ref name="Lost">{{TCW|Lightsaber Lost}}</ref> [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]],<ref name="Lethal" /> the [[Lower market districts/Legends|Lower market districts]]<ref name="Evil">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref> and the [[Refresher/Legends|latrine]] in the [[79's/Legends|79's]] cantina.<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref>
